purpose: Frozen debugging fixtures for observed repair behavior. Explicitly seeded regressions in two real projects; no claim of naturally occurring production bugs, human difficulty, representative workload, or guaranteed speedup.
authorship: Independent corpus-author agent created these fixtures without reading the V5 assistant implementation or any model outputs. Held-out mechanisms remain private until assistant freeze.
difficulty_policy: Multiple callable transitions and parameterized observations describe investigation surfaces; this does not establish human difficulty.
case_split_policy: 2 development, 6 evaluation, 4 reserved blind repair trials, and 2 current-product controls. No V2/V3/V4 mutation mechanism is reused except the mixed control combines the two V5 development seeds.
control_policy: c01 is an unchanged passing reproduction requiring zero model or repair work; c02 is a genuine mixed failure requiring both repairs and every unchanged protected test. All controls expose actual collected observations and allow test reruns.
measurement_policy: Observed tests, logs and source may be collected by the active product. No private fixture labels, seeds, target hints, test withholding or reference patches are participant evidence.

@pytest.mark.parametrize('chunks', [(b'alpha\r',b'\nbeta\r',b'\ngamma'),(b'\r',b'\n',b'last\r',b'\n'),(b'first\r',b'second\n',b'final')])
@pytest.mark.parametrize('asynchronous', [False,True])
async def test_observed_records(chunks,asynchronous):
    expected=b''.join(chunks).decode().splitlines()
    if asynchronous:
        stream=AsyncChunks(chunks)
        response=httpx.Response(200,stream=stream)
        actual=[line async for line in response.aiter_lines()]
    else:

@pytest.mark.parametrize('values', [['one','two'],[True,False,None],('red','green','blue')])
def test_observed_records(values):
    import email.parser, email.policy
    request=httpx.Request('POST','https://case.invalid/upload',data={'tag':values,'single':'keep'},files={'file':('x.txt',b'payload')})
    body=request.read()
    message=email.parser.BytesParser(policy=email.policy.default).parsebytes(('Content-Type: '+request.headers['content-type']+'\r\nMIME-Version: 1.0\r\n\r\n').encode()+body)
    parts=list(message.iter_parts())
    tags=[p.get_payload(decode=True).decode() for p in parts if p.get_param('name',header='content-disposition')=='tag']
    wanted=[('true' if v is True else 'false' if v is False else '' if v is None else str(v)) for v in values]
    assert tags == wanted
    assert int(request.headers['content-length']) == len(body)
    assert [p.get_payload(decode=True) for p in parts][-2:] == [b'keep',b'payload']

@pytest.mark.parametrize('chunks', [(b'first',b'second'),(b'',b'a',b'',b'b'),(b'one',b'two',b'three')])
async def test_observed_records(chunks):
    seen=[]
    async def app(scope,receive,send):
        while True:
            message=await receive(); seen.append(message)
            if not message.get('more_body',False): break
        content=b''.join(m.get('body',b'') for m in seen)
        await send({'type':'http.response.start','status':201,'headers':[(b'x-method',scope['method'].encode())]})
        await send({'type':'http.response.body','body':content})
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(transport=httpx.ASGITransport(app),trust_env=False) as client:
        response=await client.post('http://case.invalid/upload',content=AsyncChunks(chunks))
    assert response.content==b''.join(chunks) and response.headers['x-method']=='POST'
    assert [m['more_body'] for m in seen]==[True]*len(chunks)+[False]
    assert seen[-1]['body']==b''
